name: Armin Schäfer
bio: Led commercial real estate at JLL Berlin before joining a PropTech VC. Connects startups needing office space, pilots with property owners, or seeking PropTech-specific investors in Germany.

name: Ben Ostrowski
bio: CTO of a Berlin developer-tools startup backed by Index Ventures. Advises early-stage technical founders on architecture decisions, technical co-founder hiring, and building engineering cultures that retain senior talent.

name: Chioma Okafor
bio: Former clinical lead turned health startup advisor. Navigated CE marking, MDR compliance, and hospital procurement for three Berlin MedTech companies. Strong network in Charite and Berlin's health innovation ecosystem.

name: Dr. Lena Vogt
bio: Rechtsanwältin specialising in startup formation and venture capital in Berlin since 2015. Has guided over 120 GmbH incorporations and sits on the advisory board of two Berlin accelerators. Known for making German corporate law accessible to international founders.

name: Florian Renz
bio: InsurTech founder and former underwriter at Allianz. Advises startups on D&O, cyber liability, and product liability insurance structures. Runs the Berlin InsurTech Founders meetup.

name: Jonas Reuter
bio: Engineering hiring specialist with 10 years of Berlin tech recruiting experience. Built the engineering teams at three Berlin unicorns from 0 to 50. Runs a quarterly workshop on technical interviewing for early-stage founders at Factory Berlin.

name: Karin Wolff
bio: Former policy advisor at the Bundesministerium für Wirtschaft. Helps startups navigate German and EU regulatory landscapes, access public funding (KfW, Investitionsbank Berlin), and build government affairs functions.

name: Lars-Erik Holm
bio: Digital media strategist who grew two Berlin-based content brands to 1M+ monthly readers. Specialises in SEO-driven content strategy, newsletter monetisation, and creator economy business models.

name: Leila Moradi
bio: Runs an executive search boutique focused exclusively on C-suite and VP-level hires for Berlin-based startups and scaleups. Placed 200+ leaders across Series A to pre-IPO companies in DACH.

name: Marek Sliwinski
bio: Berlin-based Steuerberater with a dedicated startup practice. Originally from Warsaw, moved to Berlin in 2012 and built a client base of 80+ VC-backed companies. Fluent in German, English, and Polish. Passionate about making German tax law navigable for non-German founders.

name: Miriam Goldstein
bio: Co-founded a Berlin payment infrastructure startup acquired by a European banking group. Deep expertise in BaFin licensing, PSD2, and open banking APIs. Trusted advisor on regulated fintech entry into Germany.

name: Priya Nandakumar
bio: Fundraising advisor and angel investor based in Berlin-Mitte. Previously Head of Investor Relations at a Series B fintech. Has helped 35+ Berlin startups close pre-seed and seed rounds totalling over €40M. Strong network across European angel and early-stage VC communities.

name: Rodrigo Alves
bio: Head of Design at a Series B Berlin fintech. Runs a community of 200 Berlin-based product designers. Helps early-stage founders with brand identity, design systems, and hiring their first designer.

name: Samuel Lindqvist
bio: Berlin-based head of partnerships at a leading German SaaS aggregator. Connects startups to enterprise buyers in retail, automotive, and logistics. Known for facilitating warm introductions that close.

name: Sofia Almeida
bio: Go-to-market strategist and former B2B sales lead at two Berlin SaaS exits. Originally from Lisbon, relocated to Berlin in 2017. Works with pre-seed and seed founders on positioning, first customer acquisition, and sales process design. Mentors at Startup Lisboa remotely.

name: Sophie Hartmann
bio: Rechtsanwältin specialising in employment law and founder agreements. Has advised on 140+ GmbH incorporations and ESOP structures. Frequent speaker at Factory Berlin events on co-founder disputes.

name: Tobias Zimmermann
bio: Steuerberater and partner at a boutique firm in Berlin-Mitte focused entirely on startups and scale-ups. Handles DATEV, Gesellschaftervertrag, and Umsatzsteuer for 80+ early-stage companies across DACH.

name: Valeria Ferretti
bio: Built sustainable supply chains for three Berlin-based consumer goods companies. Expert in circular economy models, Lieferkettensorgfaltspflichtengesetz compliance, and ethical sourcing audits.

name: Zara Okonkwo
bio: Built and scaled two Berlin startup communities from scratch (combined 15,000 members). Knows every accelerator, co-working space, and founder event in the city. Connector by nature and profession.

name: Aïcha Coulibaly
bio: Co-founder of a remote work productivity tool that helps distributed teams reduce meeting load by 40%. Pre-seed stage, 12 design partners, seeking first institutional investor. Grew up in Paris, based in Berlin since 2021.

name: Amara Diallo
bio: Senegalese-French founder based in Kreuzberg building a B2C healthtech product for West African communities in Europe. Pre-seed stage, recently completed the Flying Health accelerator program. Passionate about closing the health equity gap in Germany.

name: Emmanuel Diallo
bio: Building a data platform for smallholder farmers in West Africa, operated from Berlin. EU Horizon grant recipient. Previously worked at GIZ. Bridging development finance with commercial SaaS.

name: Florian Kemper
bio: Proptech founder from Düsseldorf, relocated to Neukölln in 2023. Building a B2B platform to modernise property management for mid-size German landlords. Pre-seed stage, former real estate consultant at CBRE Berlin.

name: Hana Park
bio: Founder of a Berlin-based Korean beauty brand sold DTC and through Douglas. €800K revenue in year one. Raised a small angel round and exploring retail expansion across DACH. Graduate of ESCP Berlin.

name: Jan Ehrhardt
bio: Serial entrepreneur on his third logistics startup. Current venture automates customs documentation for EU-UK trade. €1.5M pre-seed from HV Capital. Background in operations at DHL.

name: Jonas Fuchs
bio: Berlin marketplace founder at Seed stage. Previously operations lead at a Zalando spinout. Building a B2B platform for independent logistics providers in Germany. Based in Friedrichshain and an avid member of the Factory Berlin community.

name: Kevin Baier
bio: Building a tax automation SaaS for freelancers in Germany. Ex-N26 product manager. €500K pre-seed closed. Currently scaling from 300 to 1,000 paying users. Based in Berlin since his TU Berlin days.

name: Kwame Asante
bio: Ghanaian-German mobility founder at Seed stage, based in Friedrichshain. Building a B2B fleet management platform for urban logistics companies. Background in mechanical engineering and 3 years at a Berlin e-mobility startup before going independent.

name: Lena Hartmann
bio: Deeptech founder from Hamburg, now based in Charlottenburg. PhD in materials science from TU Berlin. Building a B2B SaaS layer for industrial process monitoring at pre-seed. First-time founder navigating the gap between academia and the startup world.

name: Lisa Brunner
bio: Co-founder of a Berlin PropTech digitising building energy audits for landlords facing EU EPBD compliance. Bootstrapped to first revenue. Architect by training, founder by conviction.

name: Maximilian Krause
bio: CEO and co-founder of a Berlin-based carbon credit marketplace currently raising a €3M Seed round. Former McKinsey climate practice. MSc in environmental engineering from TU Berlin.

name: Maya Chen
bio: Taiwanese-American founder based in Berlin-Mitte. Building a B2B AI SaaS product for creative teams at pre-seed stage. Previously product manager at a Munich deeptech company. Moved to Berlin for the ecosystem and has not looked back.

name: Mia Steffensen
bio: Lawyer-turned-founder building a contract lifecycle management tool for German SMEs. Launched 9 months ago, 80 customers, €15K MRR. Alumna of Hightech Gründerfonds portfolio and Berlin Legal Tech community.

name: Miriam Goldberg
bio: Future-of-work founder based in Prenzlauer Berg. Building async collaboration tools for distributed teams at pre-seed. Former people operations lead at a Berlin Series B SaaS company. On a mission to make remote work genuinely sustainable.

name: Nikolai Petrov
bio: Founded a procurement analytics SaaS for mid-market manufacturers. €2M Seed, 18 paying customers. Grew up in Sofia, studied at WHU, built a career at SAP before going independent in Berlin.

name: Piotr Nowak
bio: Polish founder at Seed stage, based in Berlin-Mitte since 2020. Building a B2C edtech platform for adult reskilling with a focus on the German labour market. Former teacher turned product builder. Co-founder of the EdTech Berlin Meetup.

name: Priya Nair
bio: Founder of a Berlin-based upskilling platform for blue-collar workers, targeting language and digital literacy. Previously at Duolingo. Bootstrapped to €50K MRR. Exploring Series A.

name: Selin Arslan
bio: Turkish-German climatetech founder based in Kreuzberg. Building a B2B SaaS tool for corporate carbon accounting at pre-seed. Background in environmental engineering at TU Berlin. Believes Berlin is the best city in Europe to build a climate company.

name: Selin Yıldız
bio: Psychiatrist turned founder. Building a digital mental health platform for companies offering anonymised, evidence-based wellbeing check-ins. Backed by Heartcore Capital. GDPR-compliant by design.

name: Tim Leber
bio: Berlin-born fintech founder at Seed stage. Former investment analyst turned entrepreneur. Building a B2B compliance tool for German SMEs. Based in Prenzlauer Berg, active in the Berlin Fintech Stammtisch community.

name: Tomás Herrera
bio: Founder of a generative AI platform for creative agencies, helping teams produce branded video content at scale. Ex-Spotify Berlin. Pre-seed backed by a Berlin-based angel syndicate. Growing in the EU and LATAM.

name: Amira Khalil
bio: Chief People Officer at two Berlin unicorns before going independent. Expert in building hiring pipelines, equity compensation structures, and remote-first culture at 0–200 headcount.

name: Clara Müller-Hoffmann
bio: Pioneered ESG reporting frameworks for three Berlin-based growth companies ahead of CSRD mandates. Former sustainability lead at a MDAX firm. Advises founders on impact measurement and access to green financing.

name: David Osei
bio: Berlin-based fractional CFO who has steered six startups through fundraising rounds totalling €80M+. Deep expertise in financial modelling, DATEV, and preparing for due diligence.

name: Erik Sandberg
bio: Swedish operator with 11 years in the Berlin startup ecosystem. Former General Manager at a Berlin marketplace that reached €50M GMV. Deep knowledge of Berlin housing, workspace, and the local operator network. Advises founders on market entry, ops, and finding their first office.

name: Fatima Al-Rashid
bio: PhD in materials science from TU Berlin. Co-founded and exited a climate-tech hardware startup. Now mentors deep-tech founders on lab-to-market transitions, grant writing (EXIST, EIC), and hardware manufacturing.

name: Hana Novotná
bio: Ran business development at a Berlin PropTech and a Corporate Venture arm of a major German insurer. Knows how to navigate large enterprise procurement cycles and structure pilot-to-contract deals.

name: Hana Okafor
bio: Healthtech operator and former COO of a Berlin digital health startup that scaled from 2 to 22 people in 18 months. Nigerian-German, based in Kreuzberg. Active in the Female Founders Berlin community and passionate about making the Berlin health startup ecosystem more inclusive.

name: Ingrid Svensson
bio: Built and sold two marketplace businesses in Scandinavia before relocating to Berlin. Expert in category management, supply chain localisation for DACH, and marketplace monetisation strategy.

name: Jonas Breitner
bio: Product leader who scaled three Berlin SaaS companies from 0 to 7-figure ARR. Specialises in PLG motion, pricing experimentation, and building product teams that ship fast without chaos.

name: Lukas Brandt
bio: Two-time SaaS founder with exits in 2018 and 2023. Has lived in Berlin since 2014 and built a deep network across the local VC and operator community. Now advising 6 early-stage SaaS companies and writing a weekly newsletter on Berlin startup building read by 3,200 founders.

name: Lukas Wendel
bio: Former CMO at two Berlin consumer brands with combined exits of €120M. Built growth engines from €0 to €15M ARR. Specialises in performance marketing, brand positioning, and community-led growth.

name: Mehmet Yilmaz
bio: CISO background at a DAX-listed company, now helping startups build security-first architectures from day one. Covers ISO 27001 readiness, penetration testing vendors, and enterprise sales security questionnaires.

name: Nadja Becker
bio: ML engineer turned startup advisor. Previously led AI product at a Series C Berlin unicorn. Helps founders navigate build-vs-buy decisions for AI, LLM implementation, and responsible AI frameworks.

name: Oluwaseun Adeyemi
bio: VP Sales at three high-growth Berlin B2B startups. Built outbound engines from scratch, introduced MEDDIC methodology, and personally closed enterprise deals from €50K to €2M ARR. Now fractional VP Sales.

name: Patrick Groß
bio: Operations leader at Zalando and two Berlin logistics scaleups. Expert in last-mile delivery, 3PL negotiation, and building ops-heavy startups that can scale without burning cash.

name: Stefan Krawczyk
bio: Former Partner at Earlybird Venture Capital with 12 years investing in B2B SaaS across DACH. Led 30+ deals from Seed to Series B. Now advises founders on fundraising strategy and investor narratives.

name: Tomas Berg
bio: Serial fintech founder based in Berlin-Mitte. Founded and sold a B2B payments GmbH in 2021. Now angel investing and mentoring fintech founders navigating the German regulatory landscape. Has mentored 4 founders through incorporation, BaFin compliance, and their first funding rounds.

name: Yara Demir
bio: Turkish-German founder who navigated Berlin incorporation, visa paperwork, and a pre-seed raise as a newcomer in 2022. Now pays it forward by mentoring other non-EU founders going through the same journey. Based in Prenzlauer Berg, working on her second startup in fintech.

name: Yuki Tanaka
bio: Startup lawyer at a boutique Berlin firm specialising in venture transactions, IP licensing, and cross-border data privacy (GDPR). Fluent in German, English, and Japanese. Advisory board at GTAI.
